scope: Read-only storage integration audit while process release build is live. Supplemental observations, not pre-build source binding for the current process campaign.
facts: Initial member store opens in lifecycle.rs; successor member store opens in quv.rs. Both currently pass only state/anchor paths and custody key.
Storage paths are configuration/account scoped, not policy scoped. Bootstrap policy changes within one configuration reopen the same store.
Schema 3 member state authenticates magic/schema/generation/previous storage head/slot snapshots, but contains no provisioned-bootstrap commitment.

Pending generation+1 recovery advances the anchor after authentication before returning the store; a future bootstrap comparison must precede this recovery write to make changed-bootstrap refusal non-mutating.
Successor initialization needs explicit domain-frontier handoff semantics. Reusing Fixed bootstrap as a reset of an already accepted effect-domain history is not an admitted continuity mechanism.
next_implementation_obligation: Bind immutable provisioned domain registry at both initial and successor open paths; compare it before any recovery mutation, without inferring accepted history from registry or file generation. Durable accepted frontier and live handoff of it remain separate requirements.
